title: Edexcel GCSE Biology
description:
Complete Edexcel GCSE Biology course covering the 1BI0 specification.

Topics include:
• Key concepts in biology
• Cells and control
• Genetics
• Natural selection and genetic modification
• Health, disease and development of medicines
• Plant structures and their functions
• Animal coordination, control and homeostasis
• Exchange and transport in animals
• Ecosystems and material cycles

Includes worked examples, practice problems, and exam-style questions.
